reason: Successfully tested agent chat functionality: navigated to agent, verified status, sent arithmetic question, received correct response containing "4"
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully showing the Gamut interface with sidebar listing agents including "QA-20261016-173953-4jpz"
Found and clicked the "QA-20261016-173953-4jpz" agent in the sidebar — Successfully navigated to the agent page showing the agent home interface with message input field
